title: Self-Rewarding Language Models
authors_zh: Weizhe Yuan、Richard Yuanzhe Pang、Kyunghyun Cho、Xian Li、Sainbayar Sukhbaatar、Jing Xu、Jason Weston（Meta AI、纽约大学）
paper_type_zh: 自生成反馈与迭代偏好对齐研究
best_for_zh: 适合理解模型如何同时充当策略、数据生成器和评审器，并形成自迭代训练闭环的读者。
one_line: A language model generates and judges its own candidate answers, then improves through iterative DPO on the resulting preference pairs.
自奖励语言模型让同一模型生成候选回答并充当评审器，再用这些自生成的偏好对迭代进行 DPO 训练。
why: It turns feedback generation from a fixed external dataset into an evolving training component that can improve together with the policy.
inclusion_reason: Establishes an iterative data pipeline in which the policy also generates the judgment signals that become its next preference-training records.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Conventional feedback pipelines rely on humans or a separately trained, frozen reward model. Human judgments are expensive, and a fixed reward model cannot improve as the policy becomes stronger.

This paper asks whether a language model can generate the feedback that trains its next version. The desired result is an iterative loop in which instruction following and the ability to judge instruction-following responses can improve together.

传统反馈流水线依赖人类，或依赖单独训练且被冻结的奖励模型。人类判断成本高，而固定奖励模型无法随着策略变强而一同改进。

本文要问的是，语言模型能否生成训练其下一版本所需的反馈。它希望得到一个迭代闭环，使指令遵循能力和判断指令遵循回答的能力能够共同提升。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The same model plays two roles. As a policy it proposes answers to instructions; as a prompted LLM judge it compares those answers and emits a preference decision according to a rubric.

Those decisions become the next iteration’s DPO pairs. The reward signal is therefore not a permanent external artifact: it is regenerated by the evolving model and can, in principle, become more discriminating as the model improves.

同一个模型承担两种角色。作为策略，它为指令提出回答；作为经过提示的语言模型评审器，它依据评分准则比较这些回答，并输出偏好决定。

这些决定成为下一轮 DPO 的偏好对。因此，奖励信号不是永久不变的外部产物：它由不断演化的模型重新生成，并且原则上可随着模型提升而变得更有区分力。

title: Method
方法
html:
At each iteration, the current model generates candidate answers for instruction prompts. A judge prompt asks that model to choose the better candidate, producing chosen and rejected responses that can be consumed by DPO.

The authors repeat this generation, self-judgment, and DPO sequence for three iterations with Llama 2 70B. They evaluate both instruction-following behavior and judging quality, treating the latter as a training-relevant capability rather than a fixed evaluator property.

在每一轮中，当前模型先为指令提示生成候选回答。一个评审提示要求该模型选出更好的候选，从而产生可被 DPO 消费的优选和拒选回答。

作者用 Llama 2 70B 重复三轮生成、自我评判和 DPO 序列。他们同时评估指令遵循行为与评审质量，将后者视为与训练相关的能力，而不是固定评估器的属性。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The reported three-iteration Llama 2 70B model improves on instruction-following evaluation and achieves a strong AlpacaEval 2 result relative to several contemporary systems. The paper also reports improvement in the model’s own reward judgments across iterations.

These results support co-improvement in the reported setting, not an unconditional guarantee of self-correction. The core evidence relies on prompted model judgments and benchmark evaluations, so judge calibration, prompt choice, and contamination remain part of the interpretation.

报告中的三轮 Llama 2 70B 模型在指令遵循评测上有所提升，并在 AlpacaEval 2 上相对若干同期系统取得较强结果。论文还报告，该模型自身的奖励判断能力会随迭代改进。

这些结果支持报告设定中的共同提升，而不是无条件保证模型能够自我纠错。核心证据依赖经提示的模型判断和基准评测，因此评审校准、提示选择和数据污染仍会影响解释。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier AI-feedback approaches generally treat the judge as a fixed stronger model or a fixed reward model. This paper makes the trainable policy itself the feedback producer and repeats the construction after each update.

The contribution is thus a changing data provenance: each training round has a policy version, a judging prompt, generated alternatives, and model-produced preference labels. The feedback source is part of the system being optimized rather than a static upstream dataset.

较早的 AI 反馈方法通常把评审器视为固定的更强模型或固定奖励模型。本文让可训练策略本身成为反馈生产者，并在每次更新后重复构造过程。

因此，它的贡献是一条变化的数据来源链：每轮训练都包含一个策略版本、一个评审提示、生成的候选以及模型产生的偏好标签。反馈源是正在被优化的系统的一部分，而不是静态的上游数据集。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Self-judgment can reproduce and amplify a model’s own biases, especially when candidate diversity is low or the judging prompt is brittle. Iteration is expensive and offers no independent guarantee that improved self-agreement corresponds to better human-aligned behavior; external audits and held-out evaluations remain necessary.
自我判断可能复现并放大模型自身的偏见，尤其是在候选多样性低或评审提示脆弱时。迭代成本高，也没有独立保证表明更强的自我一致性等同于更好的人类对齐行为；仍然需要外部审计和留出评测。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when designing a pipeline in which a model must supply preference labels after an initial seed stage. It helps identify the records that must be versioned—policy checkpoint, generation prompt, judge prompt, candidate set, and preference output—so that an iterative feedback loop remains auditable.
当设计的流水线需要模型在初始种子阶段之后自行提供偏好标签时，可参考这项工作。它有助于识别必须版本化的记录——策略检查点、生成提示、评审提示、候选集合和偏好输出——从而使迭代反馈闭环仍可审计。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the judge prompt, candidate-generation procedure, and iteration boundaries as carefully as the DPO hyperparameters. When extending the method, measure agreement with independent evaluators and log the provenance of every self-generated label; otherwise later improvements cannot be separated from feedback drift.
应像阅读 DPO 超参数一样仔细阅读评审提示、候选生成过程和迭代边界。扩展该方法时，要测量其与独立评估器的一致性，并记录每个自生成标签的来源；否则就无法把后续提升与反馈漂移区分开来。
